name: working-diary
description: Record AI coding sessions as Markdown diaries or task-based Notion entries.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex work sessions to Markdown or Notion.
interface.longDescription: Working Diary adds Codex skills for writing manual Markdown diary entries and pushing task-sized session records to a hierarchical Notion database. It keeps project, purpose, task group, branch, status, categories, files, commands, commits, and dependencies available as filterable Notion columns.
defaultPrompt: Use $diary-notion to push this session to Notion.
